leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the portal vessel was comparatively bare: the result confirmed the fitting but added no detail about the route.

surprise.text: Nothing was particularly surprising; the storage, release and transport results followed the offered combinations and stated goal.

arbitrary.text: No action lacked a clear goal, but the final whole-body connection leaves the specific roles of the nerves and lymph routes unexplained.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in continuing to see how the connected systems interact, though the largely predictable sequence offers limited meaningful choice.
